title: Taking the Long View: Man City Verdict Shows Whistleblowers’ Impact Spans Years
content:
By Sandrine Rastello

The independent commission that recently found Manchester City guilty on nearly all charges of breaking Premier League rules sent shock waves through international football, threatening the future of one of the biggest clubs and straining diplomatic relations between the UK and the United Arab Emirates.

For The Signals Network, which has supported the whistleblower behind the Football Leaks that sparked the lengthy probe, it was yet another reminder that the impact of speaking up can often take years.

“Speaking up against wrongdoing can lead to major societal gains but those usually aren’t seen right away as investigations, prosecutions and legislation follow their own pace,” TSN’s Founding Executive Director Delphine Halgand-Mishra said. “The impact on the life of whistleblowers can last years, too. That’s why we must take a long view when supporting them.”
creator: Adela Prifti
sourceDescription: Holding power accountable one whistleblower at a time.
